verdict.rationale: Bland documents triggers that watch for an event and act on it, such as an agent calling the customer when a support case is created. That is a first-party, event-driven automation that runs without the user present. Batch campaigns and automatic post-call webhooks add background-run behavior around calls. missing for 10: documented recurring or scheduled automations (as opposed to event triggers and one-off batch launches), in-depth trigger configuration docs (sources, conditions, actions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A trigger watches for something to happen and acts on it. A support case is created and an agent calls the customer.
Batch calls let you initiate high-volume call campaigns by uploading a list of recipients via CSV.
Post-call webhooks are HTTP notifications that Bland AI automatically sends to your server after a phone call completes.
